subject: Issue with Correlation in Ordinal SEM

messages.author: e30e51c9400fd7ba
messages.subject: Issue with Correlation in Ordinal SEM
parts:
Hello,

Attached is the SEM I'm currently using in my research: SEM. When estimating the model in lavaan, the covariance between y1 and y2 is being estimated as 0.000. However, in previous iterations of the model where I was estimating y1 and y2 as continuous (all else the same), the covariance was being estimated as 0.45 by lavaan. Also, calculating the polychoric covariance of y1 and y2 on the side yields 0.44.

What could this problem be due to? And is there something I should do in order to enable lavaan to estimate the covariance in the attached model?

Also, I wonder how cov(y1,y2) enters the formulation of the SEM. I mean, is cov(y1,y2) included somehow in the implied covariance matrix which is used for estimation? (my reference on SEM is Bollen (1989) and I haven't ran into a case with a covariance similar to mine).

Thank you,
Deuterium
